Chosen over a chocolate-bar soldier and a peppermint disc: the widest silhouette at board size and no pink.

chibi-direction-candy-gummy-bear.subject: UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-candy-gummy-bear.notes: Playtest round 6 redesign (pulp_wars-2o7.3; the user: the Gummy Bear is too pink): the accepted jelly figure recoloured as a glossy translucent amber-orange gummy, golden where light shines through its tummy and head, burnt orange at its edges; shape, face, raised fist and canvas unchanged (66 x 72 px). It reads best of the three colours on Grass, Snow and rock.

chibi-direction-candy-marshmallow.subject: UNIT:CANDY:GUARD
chibi-direction-candy-marshmallow.notes: A fat square block of marshmallow white with a face, pink cheeks, a little pink frosting and a big graham-cracker shield held in front. Reviewed at 1:1, x4 and in the 32 px lineup.

chibi-direction-candy-pie-launcher.subject: UNIT:CANDY:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-candy-pie-launcher.notes: A gingerbread cart piped with white icing on pink peppermint wheels, with a fat pink frosting barrel holding a cream pie; the face is gone and the cupcake is a pie.

chibi-direction-candy-rock-candy-golem.subject: UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-candy-rock-candy-golem.notes: Playtest round 6 redesign (pulp_wars-2o7.3; the user: the faction is too dominated by pink): the accepted Golem with its crystals recoloured as mint-green rock candy with pale facets and a few white sugar chunks; the caramel bands, face, pose and every shape unchanged (82 x 99 px). It was the largest pink sprite of the roster.

chibi-direction-effect-candy-bounce.subject: EFFECT:BOUNCE
chibi-direction-effect-candy-bounce.notes: A squashed pink coil spring with a chocolate cap and a white motion arc.

chibi-direction-effect-candy-gumball-sho.subject: EFFECT:GUMBALL_SHOT
chibi-direction-effect-candy-gumball-sho.notes: A glossy pink gumball with a short white trail (the edit lost two of the three speed lines).

chibi-direction-effect-candy-peppermint-.subject: EFFECT:PEPPERMINT_POP
chibi-direction-effect-candy-peppermint-.notes: A pink-and-white swirl sweet bursting into striped shards.

chibi-direction-effect-candy-pie.subject: EFFECT:PIE
chibi-direction-effect-candy-pie.notes: A biscuit pie heaped with white cream and a pink sweet on top.

chibi-direction-effect-candy-rebake-puff.subject: EFFECT:REBAKE_PUFF
chibi-direction-effect-candy-rebake-puff.notes: A puff of four round pink-and-cream lumps with biscuit specks; reads as a sugar puff more than steam.

chibi-direction-effect-candy-splat.subject: EFFECT:SPLAT
chibi-direction-effect-candy-splat.notes: A white cream splat with round splashes and pink and mint edges.

chibi-direction-effect-candy-sugar-toss.subject: EFFECT:SUGAR_TOSS
chibi-direction-effect-candy-sugar-toss.notes: A pink wrapped sweet with a sparkle, nothing under it.

chibi-direction-icon-action-bounce.subject: ICON:ACTION:BOUNCE
chibi-direction-icon-action-bounce.notes: A marshmallow on a fat pink coil with two motion arcs.

chibi-direction-icon-action-frosting.subject: ICON:ACTION:CANDY:TEND_WOUNDED
chibi-direction-icon-action-frosting.notes: A white piping bag squeezing a swirl of pink frosting.

chibi-direction-icon-action-rebake.subject: ICON:ACTION:REBAKE
chibi-direction-icon-action-rebake.notes: A wire whisk with a pink handle and a pink mitt at its foot; the whisk carries the icon.

chibi-direction-icon-action-splat.subject: ICON:ACTION:SPLAT
chibi-direction-icon-action-splat.notes: A cream pie with peaks of white cream and pink blobs; a pie more than a splat, which the Splatted chip and the effect show.

chibi-direction-icon-action-sugar-rush.subject: ICON:ACTION:SUGAR_RUSH
chibi-direction-icon-action-sugar-rush.notes: A pink-and-white swirl lollipop whose stick is a white lightning bolt, with sparkles.

chibi-direction-icon-action-sugar-toss.subject: ICON:ACTION:SUGAR_TOSS
chibi-direction-icon-action-sugar-toss.notes: A pink wrapped sweet over a curved white arrow, on transparency.

chibi-direction-icon-candy-emblem.subject: ICON:HUD:CANDY:EMBLEM
chibi-direction-icon-candy-emblem.notes: A wrapped sweet with pink twisted ends: the faction emblem.

chibi-direction-icon-status-crashed.subject: ICON:STATUS:CRASHED
chibi-direction-icon-status-crashed.notes: A pink dizzy swirl in a ring with three stars over it.

chibi-direction-icon-status-splatted.subject: ICON:STATUS:SPLATTED
chibi-direction-icon-status-splatted.notes: A white splat of cream with round splashes and drips, no face.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-home-sweet-hom.subject: ICON:TECH:CANDY:FORTIFICATION
chibi-direction-icon-tech-home-sweet-hom.notes: A gingerbread house with a white frosting roof, pink hearts and gumdrops.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-peppermint-sur.subject: ICON:TECH:CANDY:EXPLOSIVES
chibi-direction-icon-tech-peppermint-sur.notes: A round pink-and-white sweet with a fuse and a white spark.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-confectio.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-confectio.notes: The apron top at the bottom of the bust is now pink frosting like the map sprite's apron (pulp_wars-jdb.9, done in pulp_wars-2o7.3); head, goggles, hat and whisk unchanged.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-donut-rac.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:RAIDER
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-donut-rac.notes: The whole pink-frosted donut with its candy-corn rider (the machine portraits' precedent).

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-gumball-g.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-gumball-g.notes: Playtest round 6 redesign (pulp_wars-2o7.3): the gumball machine close up, a globe of mixed gumballs under a dark lid on the mint base with its face and gold coin knob.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-gumdrop.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-gumdrop.notes: Playtest round 6 redesign (pulp_wars-2o7.3): the toffee cube close up with both wrapper wings, the brow and smile of the map sprite, a chocolate knob and the mint lollipop. Also the Candy setup emblem.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-gummy-bea.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-gummy-bea.notes: Playtest round 6 redesign (pulp_wars-2o7.3): the Gummy Bear's bust in the amber orange of the new map sprite; shape, face and raised fist unchanged.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-marshmall.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:GUARD
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-marshmall.notes: The white marshmallow block with its face and pink cheeks, pink frosting and a graham cracker, close up.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-pie-launc.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-pie-launc.notes: The whole gingerbread cart with pink frosting, peppermint wheels and a big cream pie, like the map sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-candy-rock-cand.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-portrait-candy-rock-cand.notes: Playtest round 6 redesign (pulp_wars-2o7.3): the Golem's bust with green rock-candy crystals like the recoloured map sprite (a little deeper green than the sprite's mint); caramel face and bands unchanged.
